basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old manga and light novel enthusiast based in Wellington, New Zealand. When I'm not hunting for the latest release of my favorite series, I spend my time exploring the great outdoors or flipping items in Old School RuneScape. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my hobbies. I'm single and enjoy engaging in lively debates, often challenging myself and others to see different perspectives. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, particularly when I'm winding down with a cup of tea.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design, and my love for manga and light novels has led me to become quite knowledgeable about the publishing industry, especially regarding international shipping and availability. My experience in online gaming, particularly in OSRS, has also given me insights into digital economies and virtual marketplaces.
